stories.title: Asset discovery
stories.description:
Create asset discovery and classification module.

Files to create:
- utils/reskin/discovery.py — AssetInfo dataclass, classify_asset(), discover_assets()
- utils/reskin/tests/test_discovery.py — tests against real Wesnoth assets

AssetInfo fields: source_path (absolute), relative_path (relative to images dir), category (sprite/portrait/icon).
classify_asset() checks path for /units/ -> sprite, /portraits/ -> portrait, /attacks/ -> icon, else unknown.
discover_assets(wesnoth_root, faction, category=None) walks:
- data/core/images/units/<faction>/*.png for sprites
- data/core/images/portraits/<portrait_faction>/*.webp for portraits (NOTE: portraits are WebP!)
- data/core/images/attacks/*.png for icons

IMPORTANT: Portrait dirs use different names than unit dirs. Map: human-loyalists->humans, elves-wood->elves, undead-*->undead, human-magi->humans, human-outlaws->humans, human-peasants->humans.
IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = {".png", ".webp"}

See docs/plans/2026-02-24-reskin-pipeline.md Task 3 for full code.

stories.title: Manifest progress tracking
stories.description:
Create the manifest module for tracking which assets have been processed.

Files to create:
- utils/reskin/manifest.py — Manifest class
- utils/reskin/tests/test_manifest.py — tests for create/save/load/mark/summary

Manifest.__init__(path, theme, faction, provider) — creates new manifest data dict.
Manifest.load(path) — classmethod, loads existing manifest from JSON file.
Manifest.save() — writes to disk (creates parent dirs with os.makedirs).
Manifest.is_completed(relative_path, source_hash) — True if status=completed AND hash matches.
Manifest.mark_completed(relative_path, source_hash, output_path) — sets status, hash, path, timestamp. Calls save() immediately.
Manifest.mark_failed(relative_path, error) — sets status=failed, error message, increments attempts count. Calls save() immediately.
Manifest.get_status(relative_path) — returns the asset entry dict or None.
Manifest.summary() — returns dict with completed/failed/total counts.

See docs/plans/2026-02-24-reskin-pipeline.md Task 5 for full code.

stories.title: Palette swap transform
stories.description:
Create the algorithmic palette swap transform for icons.

Files to create:
- utils/reskin/transforms/palette_swap.py — palette_swap(image_path, palette) -> bytes
- utils/reskin/tests/test_palette_swap.py — tests for output validity, color shifting, transparency preservation

How it works:
1. Open image as RGBA with Pillow
2. For each non-transparent pixel, classify into a color family by HSV hue:
   - reds: hue 345-360 or 0-15
   - browns: hue 15-45
   - greens: hue 75-165
   - silvers: saturation < 0.15 and value > 0.5
3. If pixel's family has a mapping in the palette, shift to target color:
   - Use target hue and saturation
   - Blend brightness: 60% source + 40% target
4. Output as PNG bytes

Helper functions: _hex_to_rgb, _rgb_to_hsv (uses colorsys), _classify_pixel_color.

See docs/plans/2026-02-24-reskin-pipeline.md Task 6 for full code.

stories.title: CLI entry point
stories.description:
Create the main CLI entry point that wires everything together.

Files to create:
- utils/reskin/reskin.py — main CLI script with argparse
- utils/reskin/tests/test_reskin_cli.py — end-to-end CLI tests via subprocess

IMPORTANT: reskin.py is run as a script, so add sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__)) before imports to ensure local modules are found. Use direct module imports (from config import load_theme), NOT package imports (NOT from utils.reskin.config).

CLI args: --theme (required), --faction (required), --category (sprites/portraits/icons), --provider (default: nano_banana), --dry-run (uses echo provider), --force (ignore manifest), --output-dir, --wesnoth-root.

Flow:
1. Load theme via load_theme()
2. Get provider (echo if --dry-run, else by name)
3. Discover assets via discover_assets()
4. Load or create manifest
5. For each asset: check manifest (skip if completed with same hash), process via appropriate transform, update manifest, handle retries (max 3)
6. Print summary (completed/skipped/failed/total)

Tests run the script via subprocess with --dry-run on icons category. Test: dry run produces files, missing theme fails, second run shows skipped assets.

IMPORTANT for test imports: test_reskin_cli.py uses subprocess to run the script directly (sys.executable + script path), NOT pytest imports. WESNOTH_ROOT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', '..', '..')

See docs/plans/2026-02-24-reskin-pipeline.md Task 9 for full code.

stories.title: Integration test
stories.description:

Test runs the CLI via subprocess with --dry-run --theme cyberpunk --faction human-loyalists (no --category, so all types). Uses tmp_path for output. Verifies:
